policies.title: Honduras: CA-4 national ordinary-passport entry
policies.summary: INM’s current visitor page directly says nationals of Guatemala, Nicaragua and El Salvador may enter Honduras under the Central American Free Movement Agreement using their national identity document or passport. This establishes a visa-free CA-4 national route, not an electronic or arrival-visa route.
conditions: The current INM page permits a passport or the stated national identity document for these CA-4 nationals; this candidate records only the ordinary-passport baseline.
The source does not set a nationality-wide visitor duration, extension, fee, onward-travel, funds, accommodation, health or port rule for this policy; none is inferred.
The migration regulation requires use of an authorized port and submission to migration control. Individual admissibility, security, health and entry conditions remain applicable.
Residence, work, transit, crew, diplomatic, official, service, refugee, stateless, special-document and third-country-document cases are excluded.

policies.title: Honduras: Bolivian ordinary passports visa-free for tourism or visits
policies.summary: SRE’s 2024 circular states that Honduras removed both the visa and entry-authorisation requirement for Bolivian holders of ordinary passports travelling for tourism or visits. This is visa-free access, not an ETA, eVisa or arrival-visa route.
conditions: Applies to Bolivian ordinary passports for tourism or visits only.
The source does not state a nationality-wide duration, fee, extension, onward-travel, funds, accommodation, health or port rule; none is inferred.
Work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service, emergency, special-document and third-country-document cases are excluded.

policies.title: Honduras: Saudi Arabian ordinary passports Category A visa-free
policies.summary: SRE’s 2024 circular moved Saudi Arabian ordinary passports from Category B to Category A without exception. Category A is Honduras’s visa-exempt classification, so the ordinary-passport baseline is visa-free rather than electronic or arrival-issued.
conditions: The circular expressly includes ordinary passports and says the category change is without exception.
The source does not state a nationality-wide duration, fee, extension, onward-travel, funds, accommodation, health or port rule; none is inferred.
Work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service, emergency, special-document and third-country-document cases are excluded.

policies.title: Honduras: United Kingdom ordinary passports require an advance consular visa
policies.summary: SRE’s 2024 ordinary United Kingdom nationality rule requires a consular visa. The current standard-passport baseline is therefore visa_required, not an ETA, eVisa or visa on arrival; the later circular provides only condition-specific exceptions.
conditions: This records the nationality-wide ordinary United Kingdom passport baseline.
The later visa-free exception for United Kingdom nationals domiciled in the Cayman Islands is conditional and is not representable by the standard GB passport code.

The narrow cruise-passenger exception requires a British passport bearing the stated British-nationality notation and applies only during time in Honduran ports; it does not establish a Hong Kong SAR ordinary-passport baseline.
Work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service, emergency, special-document and third-country-document cases are excluded.

policies.title: Honduras: Jordanian ordinary passports Category B consular visa
policies.summary: SRE’s 2024 circular assigns Jordanian ordinary passports Category B, visa consular. The ordinary-passport baseline is therefore an advance visa_required route, not an ETA, eVisa or visa on arrival.
conditions: The Category A treatment in the same circular is limited to Jordanian diplomatic, official and service passports and does not apply to this policy.
The source does not state a nationality-wide duration, fee, extension, onward-travel, funds, accommodation, health or port rule; none is inferred.
Work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service, emergency, special-document and third-country-document cases are excluded.

policies.title: Honduras: Palestinian ordinary passports Category B consular visa
policies.summary: SRE’s 2024 circular assigns Palestinian ordinary passports Category B, visa consular. The ordinary-passport baseline is therefore an advance visa_required route, not an ETA, eVisa or visa on arrival.
conditions: The Category A treatment in the same circular is limited to Palestinian diplomatic, official and service passports and does not apply to this policy.
The source does not state a nationality-wide duration, fee, extension, onward-travel, funds, accommodation, health or port rule; none is inferred.
Work, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service, emergency, special-document and third-country-document cases are excluded.
